items.title: The Monthly Checks Banks and Landlords Pay: Inside PGX, FPE and KBWY
items.summary: Three funds provide income every month, yet one payment swings wildly, one keeps shrinking, and one leans on bank balance sheets. Before you count on those funds, find out which payout can actually be trusted.

items.title: Is Invesco (IVZ) Below Fair Value After Its ETF Push?
items.summary: Invesco has delivered a 135.0% return over the past three years, which puts fresh attention on a basic question. A 135.0% gain over three years puts meaningful pressure on the idea that Invesco's market value and the returns it earns on its capital are moving in step. items.title: Major Crypto ETFs Bled $1.5 Billion While Wall Street Went Dip Shopping
items.summary: Major US crypto ETFs lost $1.48 billion in five days as stock ETFs drew $37.5 billion. Bitcoin and Ethereum led the outflows.

items.title: T. Rowe Price October AUM Falls 1.6% Sequentially Amid Net Outflows
items.summary: TROW's October AUM fell 1.6% sequentially to $1.83 trillion as $10.8 billion in net outflows and weaker equity assets weighed on growth.

items.title: ETFs Are Buying Microsoft (MSFT) on Nov. 10
items.summary: ETFs bought $337.7 million of Microsoft stock on Tuesday, with 53 funds buying and 16 selling.
